content: Transport delays introduce immediate, disruptive volatility into the system, manifesting as bottlenecks that force plant operators to continuously adjust their processing schedules in response to unpredictable material arrivals. Overarching supply chain reliability, shaped by facility closures, changing transport economics, and carrier performance, dictates the long-term predictability of these demand cycles.
